title: Identity levels
text: A brand is a market-facing name and may belong to a legal subsidiary. A parent represents the controlling organization in the company hierarchy.

title: Persistent identifiers
text: A persistent company identifier stays attached to the same business identity when display fields change.

title: Parent evidence
text: Conflicting parent relationships require a data-quality review with a source link and the expected parent.

title: Brands and parents
text: Do not substitute a holding company for a brand when the requested entity level is brand.

title: Branches
text: A branch is a location-level operation and should remain distinct from its owning legal entity.

title: Suspected merges
text: Report an incorrect merge with both company identifiers and evidence that the businesses are distinct.

title: Merge safeguards
text: Companies marked as must not merge remain separate during identity resolution.

title: Rate limits
text: When a rate limit is reached, pause requests and retry after the response retry interval.

title: Backoff
text: Use exponential backoff for repeated temporary API failures.

title: Authentication
text: A rejected credential should be replaced before retrying the request.

title: Processing states
text: An enrichment job can remain processing while its source records are being normalized.

title: Stalled jobs
text: If processing does not advance, collect the demo job identifier and elapsed time for troubleshooting.

title: Export fields
text: Exports include the persistent identifier, display name, entity level, and sourced attributes.

title: Evidence
text: Data-quality reports should include a public source link and a precise expected relationship.

title: Support scope
text: Billing and contract changes require a person and are not answered from product documentation.
